fee_notes: Continuing Royalty is 6% of monthly Gross Consumer Sales. Minimum Royalty: none for first 12 months, $600/mo for months 12-24, $1,200/mo thereafter. Additional Premium Royalty of 2.5% of Gross Consumer Sales from services provided to customers outside franchisee's Territory. Franchise Option Program royalty is 10% for 10 years. Conversion Franchise Program royalty is 2% with $250/mo minimum for first 24 months. Brand Fund Fee is 2% of Gross Consumer Sales. Technology Fee is $500/mo (waived for second or subsequent Franchised Business). Field Service Software: $729/mo for 1 tenant license and 10 user licenses. Financial Management Software: $25/mo per license. Call Routing: $20/mo. Email Licenses: $15/mo per license. Digital Marketing Services: $305/mo (basic) or $595/mo (higher tier) per territory, plus optional $49/mo add-on. Digital Lead Generation: 20% of total advertising spend or $100/mo, whichever is greater. Phone and Messaging Services: $34.99/mo per user plus $0.012 per text (optional). Agentic Customer Assistance: $0.75-$2.50 per conversation (optional). Email Marketing Services: $169/mo for up to 5,000 emails (optional). Postcard Marketing Services: $199/mo for up to 120 postcards, $1.65 per additional postcard (optional). Late Submission Fee: $100 per violation plus 12% interest per year. Transfer Fee: $5,000. Renewal Fee: $2,500. Convention Fee: up to $1,500 per attendee. Fees subject to annual increases capped at 10% (except optional fees and third-party-collected fees).
raw_excerpt:
Continuing Royalty: 6% of monthly Gross Consumer Sales. Monthly on last business day of month. See Note 2 and Note 3.
Minimum Royalty: No Minimum Royalty for first 12 months of Franchise Agreement. Minimum Royalty of $600 per month for months 12-24, and $1,200 per month for remainder of Franchise Agreement. Monthly on last business day of month. See Note 2 and Note 4.
Additional Premium Royalty: 2.5% of Gross Consumer Sales from services provided to customers geographically located outside your Territory. Monthly on last business day of month. See Note 2 and 3.
Brand Fund Fee: 2% of Gross Consumer Sales. Monthly on last business day of month. See Note 2.
Initial Training Fee: $500 per person. Before training. See Note 5 and Note 13.
Ongoing Training: Currently $500 per person. If we provide training on-site at your location, you must pay our expenses, not to exceed $5,000 per day, plus $75 per hour, per trainer. Before training and as incurred. See Note 6 and Note 13.
Late Submission Fee: $100 per violation, for any failure to pay us or provide us with information within the time in the Franchise Agreement, plus 12% interest per year, or the maximum rate allowed by law, from date amount originally due until paid. On demand. See Note 7.
Transfer Fee: $5,000. Before transfer.
Product/Supplier Approval Costs: Cost of inspection or testing, plus actual cost of laboratory fees, professional fees and travel and living expenses of our personnel, not to exceed $5,000 per request. Upon receipt of an invoice.
Audit Amount: Any unpaid amounts due, plus late payment charges from the due date at the maximum rate permitted by law, not to exceed 1 1/2% per month. If understatement is 2% or more of the Gross Consumer Sales, cost of the audit. On demand. See Note 8.
Costs and Attorneys' Fees: Will vary under the circumstances. As incurred.
Indemnification: Will vary under the circumstances. As incurred.
Convention Fee: Up to $1,500 per attendee, depending on our costs. Due at registration. See Note 9 and Note 13.
Customer Complaints: All amounts we incur to satisfy a complaint of your customer. On demand.
Step In Fee: $200 per hour per employee, plus any expenses they incur, not exceed $5,000 per day, and any attorneys' fees we incur in connection with the exercise and maintenance of the rights. On demand.
Renewal Fee: $2,500. Before renewal.
Non-compete Fee: Amount equal to our then-current initial franchise fee for each Competitive Business identified plus 7% of the Competitive Business' gross sales until expiration of the non-competition period. On demand.
Field Service Software: $729 per month, plus applicable sales taxes, for one tenant license and ten user licenses. Upon demand by vendor, or monthly on last business day of month.
Financial Management Software: $25 per month per license. Upon demand by supplier, or monthly on last business day of month.
Call Routing: $20 per month. Due monthly on last business day of month.
Email Licenses: $15 per month per license. Due monthly on last business day of month.
Digital Marketing Services: $305 per month, per territory, or $595 per month, per territory, depending on the level of service, plus $49 per month for additional optional tools. Due monthly on last business day of the month.
Digital Lead Generation: 20% of total advertising spend or $100, whichever is greater. Due monthly on the last business day of the month.
Phone and Messaging Services: $34.99 per month per user, plus $0.012 cents per text message. Due monthly on the last business day of the month.
Agentic Customer Assistance Services: $0.75 to $2.50 per conversation or call. Due monthly on the last business day of the month.
Email Marketing Services: $169/mo. for up to 5,000 emails. Due monthly on the last business day of the month.
Postcard Marketing Services: $199/mo. for up to 120 postcards. $1.65 per additional postcard. Due monthly on the last business day of the month.
Technology Fee: $500 per month. Due monthly on the last business day of the month.
